title: Summary
subtitle: Every method here is a solve, inverse, or derivative of $x = e + Ax$

points.text: Light in steady state is a sum over bounces: $x = \sum_k A^k e$
$T$ can be measured and probed optically
Volume rendering is the same equation in a medium
In neural rendering, a scene is fit to measurements
All gradients cost one adjoint solve with $A^\top$
